第十一章 千炼钢
“先锻造千炼钢，之后再铸剑。”叶石拿出一块最常见的铁矿石，直接抛入火炉。
百炼成铁，千炼成钢，即便是铁矿石锻造而成的剑，也分高低优劣。其中，最主要的就是铁矿石被提炼到怎样的地步，于是便有了‘百炼成铁，千炼成钢’这句话，说的就是将铁矿石提炼到的层次。
一块铁矿石，普通的铸剑师能够提炼个几十次就已经很难得了，优秀的铸剑师可以提炼上百次，那时候铁矿石就会被提炼成精铁，打造出来的剑比起几十练出来的铁剑质地要好上许多。
而超过五百炼的铁矿石则被称为铁精，比起精铁又高出不止一筹。其中百炼精铁和四百多炼精铁又有不低的差距，铁精也相同，所以不管是精铁还是铁精，都有高中低级，以及次等之分。
但不管是精铁还是铁精，都只能被称之为铁，唯有超过一千炼，才能称之为钢。能够锻造出千炼钢的，无一不是锻造的好手，哪怕铸剑术并不高明，但单凭这锻造铁矿石的手段，也足以保证一辈子衣食无忧。
铁矿石扔进火炉里，立刻掠起一阵漪澜，叶石紧紧的盯着铁矿石，游戏中无数次的打造经验，让叶石知道打铁，必须在铁烧红了的第一时刻便下锤。
此时叶石已经拿起炼房内的铁锤，一般打铁用的锤子分许多种，有大力的巨锤，修饰的中锤，已经细工的小锤，除此之外还有些特殊用途的锤子。可以说千奇百怪，应有尽有，但叶石不同，整个炼房内就只有手中的这把锤子。
话说这把锤子也是宝物，可是当初游戏时叶石转职任务获得的奖励物品，神器级别。可惜在转职任务打造了一套圣剑套件后，锤子就被封印了，只有等叶石等级足够时才能解开。
尽管可惜，但那圣剑套件却被叶石当做了镇店之宝，只展示给人看而不出售的宝物。要知道当初这些圣剑套件哪一柄拿出去，都能够引起整个游戏轰动的，在宝物榜上独占鳌头，而叶石拥有全部圣剑套件，也是店铺的一个活招牌。
神器锤子名为圣炼之锤，是每代神圣铸剑师的铸剑神器，属性中带有专用，也就是说出了叶石以外，没人使得了这圣炼之锤。
叶石紧紧的握住圣炼之锤，因为第一次在新世界铸剑打铁，叶石心中有些紧张。换做以前，如果知道有哪个铸剑师在打造千炼钢时会紧张，叶石肯定会嘲笑一番，或许说是报应不爽，今天终于轮到叶石了。
“出炉，上石桌。”叶石眼看铁矿石已经通红，立刻吩咐店铺系统。
炼房的功能，都是为了铸剑打铁而生，哪怕在来到新世界后有些功能失效了，但控制矿石进炉出炉都还可以。
烧红了的铁矿石飞出火炉，落在了石桌上，叶石早已经站在那里，抡起圣炼之锤猛地一挥。
当当当。
一锤三响，这是锤子打在巧力点，一锤足以媲美三锤的打造技巧。一般铸剑师能够偶尔打出两响，都会兴奋不已，但这对叶石却丝毫不成问题。
要说为什么？看叶石的表情便会知晓，此时叶石脸上浮现兴奋的神色，即便之前获得那么多金币，也不及此时的万分之一，要不是还有要事要做，叶石肯定会放声狂笑起来。
一锤三响，正是神圣铸剑师的技能之一，是个可升级的铸剑技能。叶石穿越之前，正好把等级升到三级，这才有三响，也只有神圣铸剑师这样的牛B职业，才有这样的牛B技能。
尤其是这技能没有上限，也就是说只要叶石经验够，把技能提升上去，完全有可能一锤十响，甚至一锤百响。即便是一锤完成锻造，也都有可能。

当然，前提是经验足够，要知道当初叶石可是凭借转职时的圣剑套件直接把一锤连响技能提升到二级满，结果打造了上千柄剑才堪堪达到三级最低界限，可见这一锤连响升级如何困难。
不过就算是一锤三响，也绝对能够羡煞所有铸剑师的，当然叶石兴奋的不是这个，而是技能还能用。
没错，神圣铸剑师的技能还能用，也就代表这叶石可以像以前那样铸造许多的剑具出来，这代表着什么，代表着叶石能够获得源源不断的金币。
思绪只在瞬间完成，叶石继续抡着圣炼之锤打下，铸剑打铁最忌间断，一旦间断便有可能出现杂质，使得铁矿石提炼效果下降，进而影响到剑的质地。
一锤三响，叶石足足打了一千锤，虽然只是一千炼的次等精钢，但事实上却足以媲美三千练的中级精钢。
一千锤，换做普通人早已经累的两手发酸，而这恰恰也是铸剑师打铁时无法打造出千炼钢的原因。手臂发酸，会让人不自主的出现停缓，是铸剑师自己也无法克服的障碍，因为钢铁提炼，只要一个间断，炼数直接定格，哪怕之后再下锤，也无法改变炼数，甚至只会毁了打造好的铁矿石。
叶石则不会有这样的烦恼，因为神圣铸剑师的另外一个技能，驱疲去扰。铸剑打铁过程中，可以保持一定时间的消除负面影响，尽管事后会发作，但保证铸剑打铁过程中不会出错。
同时这个技能能够提升神圣铸剑师的体力，长久下去哪怕不用使用技能，叶石也能够凭借自身达到铸剑打铁的要求。
千练钢已经完成，接下来叶石就要将千炼钢重新回炉，但这次是为了铸剑。把这刚刚锻造出了的千炼钢铸造成剑型，一柄简单的剑就完成了。当然，如果想要质地更优，甚至出现属性加成，就需要加入别的提炼矿石。
很快，在叶石找回信心，一柄成品剑就被叶石完成，询问店铺系统之下，这柄长剑型的成品剑已经达到优良质地，用普通铁矿石锻造的千炼钢铸造出质地优良的长剑，叶石已经算满意了。
只是，这长剑和之前叶石贩卖出去的长剑又略有不同，在剑身上，叶石刻意留了几个凹槽，不是那些让敌人渗血的凹槽，而是要镶入什么东西的凹槽。
来了兴趣的叶石，自然不愿意在新世界的第一次铸剑，就以一柄优良质地的长剑结束。他要给这长剑加入别的矿石，提高长剑的品质，除此之外也是实验游戏里的属性加成，会不会出现。
一番劳作之后，很快的新的长剑便完成了，剑身的凹槽上已经被新的矿石填满，只是经过叶石的铸造，从外表上看不出来了而已。即便是落在铸剑师手里，也只以为这是一柄一次性铸造出来的剑，用得是同一种矿石，绝不会想到这上面还加入了另外两种矿石。
“检查剑具属性。”叶石吩咐道，从外表上看，叶石看不出什么，但在店铺系统下长剑将被一览无遗，他可以从其知道长剑的品质如何。
这时，叶石心中有些期待起来，究竟这柄长剑，他铸造到怎样的地步。

Chapter 11 Thousand Steelmaking
"Forge steel first, then forge the sword." Ye Shi took out a piece of the most common iron ore and threw it directly into the furnace.
Iron can be made by a hundred smelting, and steel can be made by a thousand smelting. Even a sword forged from iron ore can be divided into good and bad. Among them, the most important thing is how far the iron ore is refined, so there is a saying "a hundred refinements make iron, a thousand refinements make steel", which refers to the level to which iron ore is refined.
It is very rare for an ordinary swordsmith to refine a piece of iron ore dozens of times. An excellent swordsmith can refine it hundreds of times. At that time, the iron ore will be refined into refined iron. The quality of the sword produced will be much better than that of an iron sword crafted dozens of times.
Iron ore that has been refined for more than 500 times is called iron essence, which is much higher than refined iron. Among them, there is a big gap between hundreds of refined iron and more than four hundred refined iron, and the iron essence is also the same, so whether it is refined iron or iron essence, there are high, middle, low, and inferior grades.
But whether it is fine iron or fine iron, it can only be called iron. Only when it has been refined for more than a thousand times can it be called steel. Anyone who can forge thousands of steel must be a good forger. Even if the sword-making skills are not good, the method of forging iron ore alone is enough to ensure a lifetime of food and clothing.
The iron ore was thrown into the furnace, and immediately there was a wave of ripples. Ye Shi stared at the iron ore closely. Countless forging experiences in the game taught Ye Shi that when making iron, he must hammer down the iron as soon as it becomes red.
At this time, Ye Shi had already picked up the hammer in the smelting room. There are many types of hammers used for blacksmithing, including powerful giant hammers, modified medium hammers, and small hammers that have been used for fine work. In addition, there are also some special-purpose hammers. It can be said that there are all kinds of strange things, but Ye Shi is different. There is only this hammer in his hand in the entire refining room.
It is said that this hammer is also a treasure, but the reward item obtained by Ye Shi during the job transfer mission in the game is an artifact level. Unfortunately, after creating a holy sword set in the job transfer mission, the hammer was sealed and could only be unlocked when the Ye Shi level was high enough.
Although it was a pity, Ye Shi regarded the holy sword set as a treasure of the store, a treasure that was only displayed for people to see but not sold. You must know that any one of these holy sword kits can cause a sensation in the entire game, ranking first on the treasure list, and Ye Shi owns all the holy sword kits, which is also a living sign of the store.
The artifact hammer is called the Holy Hammer. It is the sword-making artifact of each generation of sacred swordsmiths. It has special properties, which means that no one except Ye Shi has made this Holy Hammer.
Ye Shi held the Holy Hammer tightly. Because it was his first time forging swords and forging iron in the new world, Ye Shi felt a little nervous. In the past, if he knew that any swordsmith would be nervous when making Qianliang Steel, Ye Shi would definitely laugh at him, perhaps out of retribution. Today it was finally Ye Shi's turn.
"Come out of the oven and put it on the stone table." Seeing that the iron ore had turned red, Ye Shi immediately ordered the store system.
The functions of the refinery are all for forging swords and forging iron. Even if some functions fail after arriving in the new world, it can still control the movement of ore into and out of the furnace.
The red-hot iron ore flew out of the furnace and landed on the stone table. Ye Shi was already standing there, swinging the hammer of the Holy Refining and swung it violently.
Dang Dang Dang.
One hammer and three clicks, this is the hammer hitting the sweet spot. One hammer is enough to rival three hammers in craftsmanship. Most swordsmiths would be excited if they could make two shots occasionally, but this was not a problem for Ye Shi at all.
Why? You can tell by looking at Ye Shi's expression that Ye Shi has a look of excitement on his face at this time. Even if he got so many gold coins before, it is still less than one ten thousandth of what he got now. If there weren't something important to do, Ye Shi would definitely laugh loudly.
Hammering three times is one of the skills of the Holy Swordsmith. It is an upgradeable sword-making skill. Before Ye Shi traveled through time, he had just upgraded his level to level three.There are three rings, and only an awesome profession like the Holy Swordsmith can have such awesome skills.
Especially since this skill has no upper limit, that is to say, as long as Ye Shi has enough experience and improves the skill, it is entirely possible to hammer it ten times, or even hammer it a hundred times. Even completing the forging with one hammer is possible.
Of course, the premise is that you have enough experience. You must know that Ye Shi used the Holy Sword Kit when he changed his job to directly upgrade the One Hammer Continuous Skill to Level 2. As a result, he made thousands of swords before he could reach the minimum limit of Level 3. This shows how difficult it is to upgrade the Hammer Continuous Skill.
But even if it hits three times, it will definitely make all swordsmiths envious. Of course, Ye Shi is not excited about this, but that the skill can still be used.
Yes, the skills of the sacred swordsmith can still be used, which means that Ye Shi can cast many swords as before. What does this mean? It means that Ye Shi can obtain a steady stream of gold coins.
The thoughts were completed in an instant, and Ye Shi continued to strike with the hammer of the Holy Refiner. It is best to avoid interruptions when making swords and iron. Once there are interruptions, impurities may appear, which will reduce the refining effect of the iron ore, thereby affecting the quality of the sword.
With one hammer and three strikes, Ye Shi struck a thousand hammers. Although it was only inferior fine steel produced by one thousand refiners, it was actually comparable to the intermediate fine steel produced by three thousand refiners.
A thousand hammers would make ordinary people's hands sore from fatigue, and this is precisely the reason why the swordsmith cannot create a thousand hammers when forging iron. A sore arm will cause people to stop involuntarily, which is an obstacle that the swordsmith himself cannot overcome, because as long as there is an interruption in steel refining, the number of refinements will be frozen directly. Even if the hammer is hammered later, the number of refinements cannot be changed, and it will only destroy the forged iron ore.
Ye Shi will not have such troubles, because the Holy Swordsmith has another skill, which is to dispel fatigue and eliminate disturbance. During the process of sword making and iron striking, the negative effects can be eliminated for a certain period of time. Although they may occur afterwards, it is guaranteed that there will be no mistakes in the sword making and iron making process.
At the same time, this skill can improve the physical strength of the sacred swordsmith. In the long run, even without using the skill, Ye Shi can still meet the requirements of sword-making and iron-making by himself.
Qian Steelmaking has been completed, and next Ye Shi will put Qian Steel Steel back into the furnace, but this time it is to make swords. Cast the newly forged Thousand Steel into the shape of a sword, and a simple sword is completed. Of course, if you want better texture or even attribute bonuses, you need to add other refined ores.
Soon, Ye Shi regained his confidence, and a finished sword was completed by Ye Shi. After asking the store system, he found that the long sword-shaped finished sword had reached an excellent quality. It was made of Qianliang Steel forged from ordinary iron ore and made a long sword with excellent quality. Ye Shi was already satisfied.
However, this long sword is slightly different from the long swords Ye Shi sold before. Ye Shi deliberately left a few grooves on the sword body, not those grooves that let the enemy bleed, but grooves to be embedded with something.
Ye Shi, who was interested, naturally didn't want to end up with a long sword of excellent quality in his first sword-making in the new world. He wants to add other ores to the long sword to improve the quality of the long sword. In addition, it is also an attribute bonus in the experimental game. Will it appear?
After a lot of work, the new long sword was quickly completed. The grooves on the sword body had been filled with new ore, but it was only made of leaf stone and could not be seen from the outside. Even if it fell into the hands of a swordsmith, he would only think that it was a sword cast at once, using the same kind of ore. He would never have thought that two other ores were added to it.
"Check the properties of the sword." Ye Shi ordered. From the outside, Ye Shi couldn't tell anything, but under the store system, the long sword would be clearly visible, and he could know the quality of the long sword from it.
At this time, Ye Shi was looking forward to seeing how far he had cast this long sword.
